name: Commercial License Upgrade Flow V1
purpose: Convert an authenticated EGA V9 Evaluation License into an approved Commercial License without storing private signing material or issued License Keys in the Registry.
flow: The customer submits a Commercial License request using the installed Evaluation License Key.
The License Registry records the request as pending.
LCM reviews the request and commercial agreement outside the automated pricing system.
An authorized server-side command approves the request.
The Registry records Commercial License metadata but not the signed License Key.
The customer checks the request again using the existing Evaluation License Key.
The server regenerates and returns the signed Commercial License Key.
The SDK verifies and replaces the local Evaluation License Key.
Runtime License Admission subsequently admits the Commercial License.
securityRules: A valid signed Evaluation or Commercial License Key is required for customer request and status operations.
The Commercial License Key must never be stored in the Registry.
The private signing key must only exist in the License Service environment.
Commercial approval must not be exposed through an unauthenticated public endpoint.
Only the License owning the request may retrieve its status or Commercial License Key.
Commercial pricing and payment automation are outside V1.
